A small black bag and a plush toy sit inside the metal cart basket. (2) The scene shifts to a warehouse section where the woman is standing next to a pallet of large white boxes labeled 'LAGTRYCK'. The environment is a bright retail warehouse with high ceilings and industrial lighting.
